solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Officers mostly keeping horse like a sort of plot?

indicators.note: keeping means the shortened word holds the horse inside it
mostly means all but the last letter of the word is used

parts.note: police officers, collectively the police
an Arab is a breed of horse

explanation.surface: Police officers protecting a horse, in what seems to be a scheme of some kind.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'plot' is not a conspiracy but a graph plotted on axes, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A parabola is a curve drawn on a graph, so parabolic describes that shape of plotted line.

clue.text: Cost of sending item with label in place

indicators.note: in means the label word goes inside the place word

parts.note: to pose is to place or put forward
a tag is a label

explanation.surface: The price of posting a parcel that has a label on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link word; 'place' is the verb, as in posing a question.
explanation.definitionFit: Postage is the charge paid for sending a letter or parcel through the post.

clue.text: Instructions for dish — ready to eat with even bits of peach in

indicators.note: in means those letters go inside the ripeness word

parts.note: ripe fruit is ready to eat

indicators.note: even bits of means the second and fourth letters of peach

explanation.surface: A dish's method calls for ripe fruit with pieces of peach mixed in.
explanation.definitionFit: A recipe is the set of directions for preparing a particular food.

clue.text: What holds up home computer?

parts.note: a bra is a garment that holds up the bust
in means at home

explanation.surface: A question about what supports a home PC.
explanation.walkthrough: 'home computer' reads as one phrase, but 'home' belongs to the wordplay, and the question mark marks the definition as figurative.
explanation.definitionFit: The brain is the body's own computer, processing information, a playful description.

clue.text: Garland of little irises in part

indicators.note: in part means the letters are found within part of the phrase little irises

explanation.surface: A garland made of small iris flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A lei is a Hawaiian wreath of flowers worn round the neck.

clue.text: Disapproving pair of Conservatives about Democrat backing article

indicators.note: about means the pair is placed around the rest

parts.note: two words for a Conservative: CON and TORY

indicators.note: backing means the article is written backwards

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Two Tories criticising a Democrat who supports a newspaper piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pair of Conservatives' asks for two different short words for a Conservative, which wrap around the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Condemnatory means expressing strong censure, so it is a stronger synonym of disapproving.

clue.text: One teetotal in party? The same again!

indicators.note: in means the two pieces go inside the party word

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A lone non-drinker at a party asks for the same drink again.
explanation.definitionFit: Ditto is said to mean that the thing just mentioned applies once more, a repetition.

clue.text: Let down, as dipped into irregularly

indicators.note: irregularly means the letters are put in no fixed order

explanation.surface: Someone feels deflated after only dipping into something now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: To be disappointed is to feel let down when hopes are not met.

clue.text: End of school time in America

parts.note: a term is a period of the school year
US is the United States, America

explanation.surface: The close of the school term in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminus is the final stop of a route, its end point.

clue.text: Ascertain Dicky is a member of narrow group

indicators.note: dicky is British slang for weak or faulty, so the letters are out of order

explanation.surface: An instruction to find out whether Dicky belongs to some exclusive clique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' looks like a man's name, but here it is British slang for shaky or unsound.
explanation.definitionFit: A sectarian is a follower of a sect, a small religious or political faction with narrow views.

clue.text: Minor argument about head of rotten fish

indicators.note: about means the argument word goes around the letter

parts.note: a spat is a small quarrel

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of rotten

explanation.surface: A petty quarrel breaks out over a fish that has gone off.
explanation.definitionFit: The sprat is a small sea fish of the herring family.

clue.text: A quiet finish in part of book is an addition

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

indicators.note: in means the finish word sits inside the book part

parts.note: a page is a part of a book
an end is a finish

explanation.surface: A soft ending to a section of a book serves as a supplement.
explanation.definitionFit: An appendage is something attached or added on to a larger thing.

clue.text: Heavenly, a cake decoration

parts.note: angelic means heavenly, like an angel

explanation.surface: A rapturous description of a cake topping.
explanation.definitionFit: Angelica is candied green plant stem used to decorate cakes and trifles.

clue.text: Consider parking with warning light, no reversing

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

indicators.note: reversing means the warning light and no together are read backwards

parts.note: a red light warns of danger

explanation.surface: A driver is told to think about parking with a red light on and no reversing.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder is to think something over carefully, a synonym of consider.

clue.text: Language is initially just gas

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of just

parts.note: argon is a noble gas

explanation.surface: A sneer that someone's specialist talk is just hot air.
explanation.definitionFit: Jargon is the specialised vocabulary of a profession or group, a kind of language.

clue.text: Mean to state how long a person's lived

parts.note: to aver is to state firmly
a person's age is how long they have been alive

explanation.surface: Someone intends to say how old a person is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' reads as the verb intend; it is the noun, the statistical middle value.
explanation.definitionFit: In statistics the mean is the arithmetic average of a set of numbers.

clue.text: Send back alien in right vessel

indicators.note: in means the alien goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: an urn is a vessel
ET is the film alien, the extra-terrestrial

explanation.surface: An order to deport an alien found in the right kind of spacecraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' suggests a ship; it is a container.
explanation.definitionFit: To return something is to send it back to where it came from.

clue.text: Lying at home because having only half rent

parts.note: in means at home
since can mean because

indicators.note: half means the first two of the four letters of rent

explanation.surface: Someone lying in bed at home because they only paid half the rent.
explanation.definitionFit: Insincere means not genuine or honest, so it fits lying as an adjective meaning untruthful.

clue.text: Group — new one beginning to trend

indicators.note: beginning to means the first letter of trend

explanation.surface: A new band whose arrival starts a fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is a group of nine, especially nine musicians.

clue.text: One going around with horn

indicators.note: going around means the letters are spun into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A beast wandering about with a horn on its head.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: the letters of one (as a numeral) and horn mixed up give the animal the clue describes.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhinoceros is the large African and Asian beast famous for the horn on its nose.

clue.text: Spider natural at running

indicators.note: running means the letters are set loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: A spider that is a born sprinter.
explanation.definitionFit: The tarantula is a large hairy spider.

clue.text: Polish in game with British

parts.note: RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: A Polish player in a match alongside a Briton.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' with its capital looks like the nationality; it is the verb to shine.
explanation.definitionFit: To rub a surface is to buff it until it shines.

clue.text: Sauce good with fish around five

indicators.note: around means the fish word encloses the numeral

parts.note: a ray is a flat fish
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: A recipe note: a sauce goes well with fish served at about five o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Gravy is the sauce made from meat juices, poured over a roast.

clue.text: Be taunted about young girl in society

indicators.note: about here means turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: A young society girl gets mocked.
explanation.definitionFit: A debutante is a young upper-class woman making her first appearance in fashionable society.
